prompts: Mellow lo-fi hip hop instrumental for an 90-second animated explainer aimed at small business owners. Dusty Rhodes electric piano chords, warm round bass, soft boom-bap drums with a relaxed swing, light vinyl crackle, a gentle muted guitar lick. Laid back but polished and professional, around 85 bpm, sparse and steady so a voiceover sits clearly on top. Instrumental only. Soft start, a small lift around 50 seconds, a warm resolved final chord at 86 seconds that rings out to the end.
